title: Shah kehte the meri aankh ke taare abbas
body:
SHAH KEHTE THE MERI AANKH KEY TAARE ABBAS
BHAI KO CHORD GAYE KISKEY SAHARE ABBAS
MAINE BACHPAN MEIN JHULAYA THA TUMHARA JHULA
TUM HO ASGHAR KI TARAH RAJ DULHARE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
APNI MASOOM BHATIJI KI MADAD KO AAO
SO NAHI PAATI HEIN WO DARD KEY MAARE ABBAS
PANI BEHTE HUE MASKIZE SE JIS DAM DEKHA
MERI AANKHAO SE BAHE KHOON KEY DHARE ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
KOUN CHINEGA RIDA KEHTI THI BINTE ZEHRA
SAB KO HEIN ILM KEY HEIN SATH HAMARE ABBAS
NEHAIR PE GHAZI KA LASHA THA TADAPTA PAIHAM
HAR TAMACHAOUN PE SAKINA NEY PUKARA ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
KUCH GHADI PEHLE THEY TUM HATOUN MEIN PARCHAM THAMEIN AUR AB SOTE HO TUM NEHAIR KINARE ABBAS
